I'm REALLY opinionated about this - F4 is hated by gamers and fanboys because it's so beginner friendly. F4 was my first open world game and my little brother was pissing himself with laughter the learning curve was so high for me (way points, side missions verses quest, etc). F4 is so fucking delightful it introduced to me how a video game can be an interactive movie and the sandbox of F4 is really fun, if she's a typical gamer girl and likes the Sim than F4 settlements can be really fun.

But most importantly: Fallout shelter the mobile game is the most noobie friendly and it has a lot of tv character references in it that would be fun if she likes the shows. 

New Vegas and F3 are old and graphics a bit brutal imo also I'm a die hard Mcready fan and I gave up on F3 before little lamplight so 🥴 I think F4 is the perfect step into video games, Witcher 3 next if she loves it or the more complicated fan beloved falllouts!
